---
name: Bug report
about: Report a problem with walking, rendering, input, audio, or saved progress
labels: bug
---

## Problem

Describe the result you saw and the result you expected.

## Reproduction

Give the shortest sequence that reproduces the problem.
Attach a screenshot or relevant log output when it explains the failure.

## System

Include the game version, operating system, and whether you used an exported package or the Godot editor.
